description: This file defines the GatewayServiceResolver class, which resolves network services using Bonjour (NetService). It handles DNS service resolution and provides the resolved host and port information asynchronously via a callback.

classes.name: GatewayServiceResolver
classes.description: A resolver class that uses NetService to locate and resolve Bonjour network services, providing the host and port information asynchronously.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the resolver with service name, type, domain, and a completion callback.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the service resolution process with an optional timeout.

methods.name: netServiceDidResolveAddress
methods.description: Delegate method called when the service address has been resolved; extracts host and port.

methods.name: netService
methods.description: Delegate method called when resolution fails.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Handles cleanup and calls the completion handler with the result.

methods.name: normalizeHost
methods.description: Static method to normalize the hostname obtained from the service.
